title: Monster Hearts
description: Replaces your hearts with Monster Souls from Undertale.
body:
This texture pack replaces all of the HP hearts with monster hearts from Undertale. That's it. This was going to be part of another mod, but i scrapped that one.

Also, I have a feedback form now! Check it out [here](https://forms.gle/yoqKg2okEsmqeWFx6)!
